run_sac_cartpole_experiment: run the SAC reinforcement learning experiment on the ContinuousCartPole environment with configurable hyperparameters
create_gym_env: create a ContinuousCartPole Gym environment instance for reinforcement learning training
create_env: create a batch of TimeLimit-wrapped Gym environments wrapped in a GymEnv container
create_train_env: create a batch of TimeLimit-wrapped Gym environments wrapped in a GymEnvInf container for training
create_agent: create an SACAgent instance with a given policy and optional action dimension
